name: Selvin PaulRaj K — Portfolio Agent
description: Agent for AI Engineer Selvin PaulRaj K (Chennai, India; open to AI Engineer roles). Send a job description for an evidence-cited fit report (deterministic, no LLM), ask a question for a grounded answer that cites portfolio sources, or send an empty message for his profile.

skills.name: Job fit check
skills.description: Matches a job description against Selvin's production work, projects, and certifications. Returns a 0-100 score, each requirement with cited evidence, and the gaps. Chosen automatically for text that reads like a job description (max 20,000 characters).
examples: We are hiring an AI Engineer with LangGraph, RAG, FastAPI and AWS experience...

skills.name: Profile summary
skills.description: Selvin's role, experience totals, featured projects, certifications, contact links, and the roles he is open to. Set message.metadata.skillId to 'profile' (an empty message also gets it).
examples: Who is Selvin and what does he work on?

skills.name: Ask about Selvin
skills.description: Answers a question about Selvin's work, skills, projects, or experience from his portfolio only. Every [n] in the answer cites a returned source (title, URL); off-topic questions and injection attempts are refused before any LLM call.
examples: Which MCP servers has Selvin built?
Does he have production RAG experience?
